name: scroll_compressor_semi_empirical
title: Semi-empirical hermetic scroll compressor in a refrigeration cycle
summary: Reference model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002) as implemented by V. Lemort: six-step compression path (supply drop, heating-up, isentropic compression to the adapted pressure, isochoric compression, exhaust cooling, exhaust drop) with internal leakage, fictitious-wall heat transfers and electromechanical losses; parameters identified on a Copeland ZR72KC-TFD catalogue, refrigerant cycle reduced to an evaporator and a condenser at imposed saturation temperatures. A simplified variant without leakage (converted from the EES original in bar/kJ units) is included.

authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (last run: t_ev = 7 °C, t_cd = 45 °C, R22); simplified variant against the EES stored solution of CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip:scroll_compressor.EES (t_ev = 30 °C, t_cd = 40 °C), converted to SI
verification.notes: Main model: all key outputs (M_dot_r, W_dot_cp, Q_dot_ev, Q_dot_cd, t_ex_cp, t_w_cp, efficiencies) within 0.1%; largest deviation 1.5% on the small derived quantity w_in2_cp (EES 7.9 vs CoolProp R22 properties). Variant: key outputs within 0.1% after hand conversion bar/kJ -> Pa/J; deviations only on intentionally converted cells (C_sd_cp, DELTAp_su1_cp).
